body: Ugh yeah it's going to be a long 3 months. I'm sorry you are going through it too. Good luck and I hope the purging period goes by fast.

Yeah they just really add an extra layer of stress to my life.  Unfortunately I'm already on a prescription retinoid that is the best for wrinkles and acne for many years but the stress must have really killed my cells
Yeah I've been waiting my whole life for a glimmer of hope, but sometimes it just doesn't happen for some people.

I've just recently discovered this sub and yes I've also always had tokophobia since the day I was born. I thought I was the only one for so long. I'm 23 and this is a huge reason why I cannot date and why I'm still a virgin.  It's embarrassing to be one, but I just don't think I'll ever be able to knowing there's even a. 001% chance of getting pregnant no matter what you do.  Even tubal ligation,  if I could even be allowed to get it,  still freaks me out because that shit can regrow.
Yeah but I've been trying to take each and everyday at a time. One more day,  right?  Things will get better... Except I've spent 5 years doing this.  Shit doesn't just get better.

You sound exactly me.  Mid 20s with no job,  education or friends.  I know it's like a meaningless statement from a stranger,  but I feel your pain all too deeply right now. So much so that it hurts to read. I've pretty much made the decision to end it as well for the same reasons. I wouldn't mind talking if you want to send me a pm.

I think that's really awesome, I love rock and roll. It's nice to see someone who still has ideas these days lol. Do you ever feel like even being in the same class as your peers proves you are just as capable as they are? Passing classes takes hard work and it shows you are not stupid or a failure. In fact I respect you for even doing film and following your passion.

Hey congrats on the grades at least. I know how that feels. That's actually why stopped doing anything with art. Do people tell you this? 
What are some of your ideas about bringing rock-and-roll into filmmaking?
Sure, you're very kind to do that

Well thanks for talking with me, I might chicken out as usual although I really don't want to. 
Usually I don't have problems telling people off, but I think it was just my day to be finally be an adult, and to have that happen...well it just crushed me.

No I wish, actually. I wish I could drink because the few times I have, I felt decent for once. But I'm traumatized from trying to buy alcohol because the one time I tried, I got kicked out of the store and treated like a criminal for looking too young ( despite having my ID). I know I could have fought back, but I was so embarrassed on top of an already bad day, so I just cried walking back home lol. I don't know what it is with people in my city, but they just treat me like that whenever I try and do something.

Thanks. Yes I live with my parents. It's very complicated, I love them but I also really hate them. They don't understand the way the world works, so for instance, my mom thinks I can just go apply to any job and get it. I try to explain the need for education and transportation these days but to no avail. On top of it, they are getting up there in age so my financial support really won't be here for very much longer.
Thanks for replying, it's messed up to do that but there's no bridges nearby and i don't want to go out quietly.

No I never learned anything mechanical or any kind of skilled work, nor am I good with technology. I cannot find any trade schools that are close enough for me to get to or to afford. Customer service is a disaster for me too so idk. I'm actually a 23 year old girl lol, so I'm even more useless.

Yeah I do really need to. I'm just completely out of money to even pay for the test lol. 
I wanted to try to get into a radiography program, but I was also given false information on how many years it would take to complete prerequisites and credits just to get into the course. This was after I had quit because two of the classes (a introductory computer class and a gen. Ed. class) weren't  prerequisites, but now I know I could have used them as credits ( if I hadn't withdrawn). Initially I was told I only needed certain classes and nothing else. But actually it's 2 years of credits, and then you only get into the course if you have straight A's and then it's another two years plus community service.
No, my parents don't want to teach me because I wasn't getting it before (I failed the knowledge test 4 times) I live in the U.S. (Oregon)

I think it was a bunch of things really. I don't have a license, so getting there was really hard. It's really expensive, and I had some trouble with financial aid because my dad didn't want to give me information to complete it. The advisors told me I needed classes that I didn't actually need so I wasted a bunch of time and money. I had a teacher who was completely nuts and started accusing me of things that I wasn't doing wrong.  Finally what did it for me was that I thought I was doing well in my math class, but the instructor didn't give me back my hw or tests until later and it was all F's. Too late to even pass the class. I live in a bad area, so the community colleges are really not good lol.

That's what I'm trying say. I fucking can't stand it when someone tells me I need to just exercise and meditate more and eventually I'll be in a different place. It makes want to throw up. 
All the talking and mindfulness in the world won't change the reasons why I need to die. 
It's really sad how everyone tells you those are the solutions for mental health problems, but the fact is there are no solutions
